goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The plot auto-claimed, cash came in, and the playtester bought Dropper 2, Speed 1 and Silver Ore from the SHOP, then walked to the Dropper 3 and Cash x1.5 pads. It never went to the plaza to look at the TOP TYCOONS board, and it never used the green Dropper 2 pad. The Gold Ore Buy button in the shop did not fire twice, and the probe reported no server errors.

bugs.title: Shop 'Buy' button for Gold Ore does not fire and gives no feedback
bugs.evidence: Steps 14 and 17: pressing ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_tier_gold.State ('Buy' at 739,744) returned 'button did NOT fire' with cash at about 1.6K to 2K. Ownership and cash did not change, and shop_purchases stayed at 3. The other shop cards (Dropper 2, Speed 1, Silver) fired fine. The button may be clipped at the bottom of the list, or the click is silently rejected with no 'not enough cash' message.

bugs.title: TotalEarned attribute is about 1e12 on a fresh plot while rebirth says not ready
bugs.evidence: The playtester saw TotalEarned go 1000000000234 -> 1000000000258 -> 1000000000378 while Cash was only 150 to 330. Rebirth presses (steps 4, 9, 15) and the altar prompt only showed 'Not ready to rebirth', and rebirth_denied reached 6. This may be a seeded or corrupted stat. It could affect rebirth gating or the TOP TYCOONS board.

bugs.title: Purchased upgrade pads keep showing their buy price
bugs.evidence: After Silver Ore was bought (step 5) the pad still read 'Silver Ore | $60'. After Cash x1.5 was bought (step 11) the pad still listed 'Cash x1.5 | $300'. The pads are no longer touchable, so the stale labels are confusing for a new player.

bugs.title: Tutorial is re-shown very often
bugs.evidence: The probe counter tutorial_reshown is 31 against only 4 tutorial_steps in an 18-step session. The tutorial may be re-triggering repeatedly and nagging the player.
